Field.Label: Backs up the memory of your Z-Wave USB controller (Home ID, node table, routes) to a file, and can write it back. Backups run from the plugin menu and need Z-Wave switched off for about two minutes: the plugin waits for you to do that and tells you when to switch it back on. Nothing here needs a password or a key.
